findings.source_quote: And my will toward Him turns?
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha mstari huu uwe: “Na nia yangu kumwelekea Yeye?”

findings.source_quote: To seek and to search, to stay by His side,
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha “kumchunguza” kwa “kumtafuta kwa bidii,” ili mstari useme: “Kumtafuta na kumtafuta kwa bidii, kukaa kando Yake,”
findings.translation_quote: Kumtafuta na kumchunguza, kukaa kando Yake,
